values.note: Read on Campspot: one night for 2 adults, site rate before tax and Campspot's $3 booking fee (list prices $48-78 include it). June and July 2027, weekday and Saturday alike: Tent or Small RV Site $45 (1 site, to 25 ft, shared water, no electric), Water/Electric $60, 30-amp full hookup $65, 30/50-amp full hookup and buddy sites $70, premium pull-through $75. Campspot's RV-type lists name motorhomes only on the full-hookup types ($65-75); the $45 and $60 types list vans, truck campers, pop-ups and (W/E) trailers. Up to 4 people included; extra fees for a 5th/6th guest and a 3rd pet. Read 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-21.

summary: Confirmed Campspot booking, $45-75 base (unchanged since 10-13), 50 A/water/sewer, season May 1-Oct 30, phone 607-869-9787, laundry. Added 57 sites (41 RV) to 45 ft with pull-throughs, showers, dump, store, Wi-Fi, booking note. No monthly/seasonal sales seen; 1-night stays open on summer Saturdays. Note unchanged.
flags: Price gate (private, never stayed, no gateway within 40 km; nearest Rochester 86 km): the $45 base is the single 'Tent or Small RV Site' (max 25 ft, shared water, no electric, Campspot rvTypes Pop-Up/Van/Truck Camper/Tent - no Motorhome), and the $60 Water/Electric type also omits Motorhome. The cheapest type Campspot lists for motorhomes is the 30 A full hookup at $65 (list $68), over US$50. A human should decide whether EKKO (van-chassis) counts as a 'Van' here.
